Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Two questions:

1. A Methuselah creates X vampires by means of Shock Troops. Can
one of that Methuselah's other vampires play Revelations of the Sire on
one of those newborn?. If so, can Revelations of the Sire be played on
a Pander, as well as on a Caitiff?. (Although card text specifies that
RotS
can only be played on a Caitiff, I think it could be plausible to play
it on
"clanless" vampires [i.e., Pander]).

2. This question is about Clan Impersonation. Can a "Sabbat" Brujah
Antitribu
Clan Impersonate into a Camarilla Brujah Antitribu?.

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Damnans wrote:
>
> Two questions:
>
> 1. A Methuselah creates X vampires by means of Shock Troops. Can
> one of that Methuselah's other vampires play Revelations of the Sire on
> one of those newborn?. If so, can Revelations of the Sire be played on
> a Pander, as well as on a Caitiff?. (Although card text specifies that
> RotS
> can only be played on a Caitiff, I think it could be plausible to play
> it on
> "clanless" vampires [i.e., Pander]).

No. Card text says (and means) "Caitiff". Random clanless vampires are
not "Caitiff". Caitiff are vampires with the Caitiff symbol on them or
with card text saying they are Caitiff.

> 2. This question is about Clan Impersonation. Can a "Sabbat" Brujah
> Antitribu
> Clan Impersonate into a Camarilla Brujah Antitribu?.

No. He can impresonate A Burjah however (and would thus be Camarilla),
or he can hold a Writ of Acceptance (and would thus be a Camarilla
Brujah antitribu).

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>1. A Methuselah creates X vampires by means of Shock Troops. Can
>one of that Methuselah's other vampires play Revelations of the Sire on
>one of those newborn?. If so, can Revelations of the Sire be played on
>a Pander, as well as on a Caitiff?. (Although card text specifies that
>RotS
>can only be played on a Caitiff, I think it could be plausible to play
>it on
>"clanless" vampires [i.e., Pander]).

No. The Shock Troop vampires are clanless Sabbat. They are neither Caitiff nor
Pander. And since RofS requires Caitiff, a RofS can not be played on them. For
similar reasons (due to explicit card text), a RofS cannot be played on a
Pander either. Even though they're all techncially "clanless" (though Pander
kind of is a clan), for Jyhad/VTES purposes, there's just something special
about the Caitiff...

>2. This question is about Clan Impersonation. Can a "Sabbat" Brujah
>Antitribu
>Clan Impersonate into a Camarilla Brujah Antitribu?.
>

No. When you change clans, you also change sect-allegiance. So the a Sabbat
Brujah Anti can become a Camarilla Brujah (normal) or Sabbat Brujah Anti. You
can't Clan Impersonate into a Sabbat Brujah (normal) or a Camarilla Brujah
Anti.

You can however use the Writ of Acceptance to become Camarilla while
maintaining Brujah Antitribu clan status though.

Halcyan 2
